transcript.sourceText: THE CORE IDEA
transcript.text: THE CORE IDEA

runs.text: Inflation redistributes purchasing power when it differs from expectations and creates shoeleather, menu, and relative-price costs. Actual inflation was higher than expected, so borrowers repay with less valuable dollars. Menu costs are costs of changing posted prices. Shoe-leather costs refer to the time and effort people spend reducing money holdings when inflation is high. Shoeleather costs are the wasted effort people spend trying to hold less money during inflation.

Time: 5 minutes
Outcome: Analyze redistribution, shoeleather costs, menu costs, and price distortions.
Difficulty: Intermediate
THE CORE IDEA

Inflation redistributes purchasing power when it differs from expectations and creates shoeleather, menu, and relative-price costs. Actual inflation was higher than expected, so borrowers repay with less valuable dollars. Menu costs are costs of changing posted prices. Shoe-leather costs refer to the time and effort people spend reducing money holdings when inflation is high. Shoeleather costs are the wasted effort people spend trying to hold less money during inflation.
HOW TO RECOGNIZE IT
Shoe-leather costs refer to the time and effort people spend reducing money holdings when inflation is high.
Shoeleather costs are the wasted effort people spend trying to hold less money during inflation.
Menu costs are the costs firms face when they change posted prices.
Firms repeatedly changing posted prices incur menu costs.
Menu costs are the costs of changing posted prices.
WATCH OUT
Do not confuse shoeleather costs with menu costs. Shoeleather costs are the wasted effort people spend trying to hold less money during inflation.
WORKED EXAMPLE: UNEXPECTED INFLATION REDISTRIBUTION

A lender makes a 9% loan expecting 3% inflation, so the expected real return is 6%. Actual inflation turns out to be 10%, making the realized real return approximately 9% - 10% = -1%. Unexpected inflation transfers purchasing power from the lender to the borrower.
